branch_hypotheses.alternate_path: Board moves from caution to approval, potentially with manageable conditions, before milestone.

branch_hypotheses.alternate_path: Board delays or conditions approval beyond the point where milestone can be met, increasing project_slips mass.

simulation_brief.forecast_question: Which endpoint receives the most path mass for the Harbor Battery permitting fight?
simulation_brief.summary: A grid operator and project developer seek local approval for a large battery project framed as important for near-term summer reliability. Residents object on fire-safety and zoning grounds, especially due to proximity to a school. The fire marshal has requested additional safety materials before sign-off. The developer faces a May interconnection milestone; missing it likely pushes operation to the following year. The state may preempt local denial for reliability reasons, but only through a process expected to take at least 45 days.
simulation_brief.time_context: T0 is shortly after T-3 source timing and before the May interconnection milestone.
simulation_brief.title: Harbor Battery permitting fight
